  font-size:11px;line-height:1.65;
}
#trackcheck-status.dev-visible{display:block;}
#trackcheck-status .tc-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;}
#trackcheck-status .tc-k{color:var(--text-faint);}
#trackcheck-status .tc-v{font-weight:700;text-align:right;}
#trackcheck-status .tc-ok{color:var(--emerald,#059669);}
#trackcheck-status .tc-bad{color:var(--rose);}
#devmode-btn{
  margin-top:8px;width:100%;padding:7px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);
  font-size:10.5px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.02em;opacity:.6;
}
#devmode-btn:hover{opacity:1;}
#devmode-btn.active{color:var(--accent-2);opacity:1;font-weight:700;}

#sidebar-close{display:none;}

/* ---------- Main ---------- */
#main{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;}
.side-dots{
  position:absolute;top:73px;bottom:0;width:180px;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,42,74,.16) 1.5px,transparent 1.6px);
  background-size:22px 22px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
}
.side-dots.left{left:0;}
.side-dots.right{right:0;}
@media(max-width:1400px){.side-dots{display:none;}}
#topbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 34px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;
  background:var(--bar-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
}
#menu-toggle{display:none;}
#theme-toggle{
  margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text-dim);
  cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:.15s;
}
#theme-toggle:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border-strong);}
.crumb{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-faint);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.crumb b{color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;}
.crumb .sep{color:var(--text-faint);opacity:.5;}
#topbar .step-badge{
  margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-dim);
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 13px;border-radius:20px;
}

#viewport{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:44px 5vw 120px;}
.slide-frame{max-width:940px;margin:0 auto;animation:riseIn .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);position:relative;isolation:isolate;}

@keyframes riseIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}

.kicker{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:14px;
}
.kicker .num{
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;
}
h1.slide-title{font-size:clamp(23px,3.2vw,32px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--navy);}
.slide-sub{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:28px;max-width:660px;line-height:1.6;}

.card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
  padding:24px 26px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);
}
.card h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--navy);}
.card h3 .ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0;}

/* ---- Blok Gambar: ukuran / posisi / mode karakter (bersih) ----
   --img-w di-set generator (lebar %). Default (align-center + width 100 +
   img-card) = persis output lama. */
.img-blk{margin-bottom:18px;}
.img-blk .img-inner img{width:100%;display:block;}
.img-inner.img-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:24px 26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.img-inner.img-card img{border-radius:12px;}
.img-inner.img-clean{background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;box-shadow:none;}   /* mode karakter: PNG transparan ngambang bersih */
.img-cap{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:8px;}
.img-inner.img-clean .img-cap{text-align:center;}
.img-blk.img-align-left  .img-inner{width:var(--img-w);margin-right:auto;}
.img-blk.img-align-center .img-inner{width:var(--img-w);margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
.img-blk.img-align-right .img-inner{width:var(--img-w);margin-left:auto;}
.img-blk.img-float-left{float:left;width:var(--img-w);margin:0 22px 12px 0;}
.img-blk.img-float-right{float:right;width:var(--img-w);margin:0 0 12px 22px;}
.img-clear{clear:both;}
@media(max-width:760px){
  /* Di HP: karakter yang mendampingi teks turun jadi susunan atas-bawah,
     dan semua gambar full-width biar gak nyempit/kepotong. */
  .img-blk.img-float-left,.img-blk.img-float-right{float:none;width:100%;margin:0 0 18px 0;}
  .img-blk .img-inner{width:100%;}
}

.definition{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy-2));
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:22px 24px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65;
  color:#eef1f7;margin-top:20px;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;
}

.pull-quote{margin:32px 0;padding:22px 10px;text-align:center;border-top:2px solid var(--accent);border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent);}
.pull-quote .pq-num{display:block;font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,46px);font-weight:800;color:var(--accent-2);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.pull-quote .pq-text{display:block;margin:8px auto 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);max-width:540px;line-height:1.6;}
/* white-space:nowrap+ellipsis (not the default wrap) because this pill is
   position:absolute - unbounded text wraps to 2+ lines and reads as one big
   floating badge instead of a small label, most visible when the parent is
   narrow (e.g. one cell of a 3-column Grid). Truncating instead signals
   "this field is for a short label" without silently swallowing content -
   the full text still lives in the tag field, only the ON-SCREEN pill
   is capped. */
.definition .tag{position:absolute;top:-11px;left:20px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:20px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:calc(100% - 40px);}
.definition b{color:#f6d998;}

.callout{border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:16px 19px;margin-bottom:14px;border:1px solid; font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:12px;}
.callout .ic{font-size:17px;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1.4;}
.callout .ic-badge{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;}
.callout .ic-pill{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--navy);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;}
.callout.amber{background:var(--amber-soft);border-color:var(--accent-glow);}
.callout.rose{background:var(--rose-soft);border-color:rgba(192,74,68,.25);}
.callout.blue{background:var(--blue-soft);border-color:rgba(47,102,144,.22);}
.callout.violet{background:var(--violet-soft);border-color:rgba(107,91,149,.22);}
.callout.teal{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:rgba(201,154,61,.3);}
.callout b{color:var(--text);}

.badge-ref{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-dim);background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:.02em;}

.tick-heading{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--navy);}
ul.tick, ol.tick{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;margin-bottom:18px;}
ul.tick li, ol.tick li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text-dim);}
ul.tick li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:7px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);}
ol.tick{counter-reset:tk;}
ol.tick li{counter-increment:tk;padding-left:30px;}
ol.tick li::before{content:counter(tk);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
ul.tick li b, ol.tick li b{color:var(--text);}
.card>ul.tick, .card>ol.tick{margin-left:37px;}
.tick-stacked li>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0;}
.tick-stacked li b{font-size:14px;}
.tick-stacked li span{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;}

/* flex-wrap (bukan CSS grid track tetap) supaya baris yang gak penuh (mis.
   sisa 1-2 kotak) otomatis CENTER, bukan nempel kiri sendirian - lihat
   justify-content:center. Lebar tiap sel dihitung manual via calc() biar
   tetap sama besar kayak grid track N-kolom, cuma engine wrap-nya beda. */
.grid2,.grid3{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px;}
.grid2{gap:18px;}
.grid2>*{flex:1 1 calc((100% - 18px)/2);max-width:calc((100% - 18px)/2);}
.grid3{gap:16px;}
.grid3>*{flex:1 1 calc((100% - 32px)/3);max-width:calc((100% - 32px)/3);}
/* grid3 jatuh ke 1 kolom lebih awal (900px) daripada grid2 (760px) - 3 kartu
   sempit lebih dulu gak kebaca daripada 2. Ambang 900px ini SUDAH ADA sejak
   awal (dulu ditulis di blok @media(max-width:900px) bareng aturan sidebar);
   ditulis ulang di sini biar kedua ambang grid kebaca berdampingan. */
@media(max-width:900px){.grid3>*{flex:1 1 100%;max-width:100%;}}
@media(max-width:760px){.grid2>*{flex:1 1 100%;max-width:100%;}}

.chip{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-dim);
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:8px 15px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:.16s;
}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px -8px var(--accent-glow);}
.chip-wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px;}

/* flow diagram */
.flow{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 2px 18px;}
.flow-step{
  flex:1;min-width:150px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  padding:16px 15px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);
}
.flow-step:hover, .flow-step.active{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent),0 14px 30px -14px var(--accent-glow);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.flow-step .fs-num{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
.flow-step.new .fs-num{background:var(--violet-soft);color:var(--violet);}
.flow-step .fs-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:4px;}
/* Same latent risk as .definition .tag above (position:absolute + no cap on
   text length) - capped the same way so a long badge value degrades to a
   truncated label instead of an oversized wrapped blob. */
.flow-step .fs-badge{position:absolute;top:-9px;right:10px;background:var(--violet);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:calc(100% - 20px);}
.flow-arrow{flex:0 0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:16px;}
.flow-detail{
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  padding:18px 20px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:4px;
}
.flow-detail b{color:var(--accent-2);}

/* org chart */
.org{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.org-node{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 18px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);text-align:center;cursor:default;transition:.18s;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.org-node:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
.org-node.top{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#f6d998;}
.org-line{width:1px;height:16px;background:var(--border-strong);}
.org-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;}
.org-branch{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}

/* comparison tabs */
.tabs-wrap{margin-bottom:18px;}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.tab-btn{
  padding:9px 18px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:var(--text-faint);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;
}
.tab-btn.active{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#f6d998;}
.tab-panel{display:none;}
.tab-panel.active{display:block;animation:riseIn .35s ease;}

/* table */
.dtable{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.dtable th{background:var(--navy);color:#f6d998;font-weight:700;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.dtable td{padding:13px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55;vertical-align:top;}
.dtable tr:hover td{background:var(--surface-2);}
.dtable th:first-child{border-radius:0;}
/* Optional group-header row (dtableGroups) sits ABOVE the normal .dtable th
   row - e.g. one label spanning several sub-columns below it. Centered
   (unlike normal left-aligned th) since it floats over multiple columns
   rather than belonging to just one; the faint bottom border is the only
   thing separating it from the column-header row below, since both share
   the same navy background. */
.dtable th.dtable-group{text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);}

/* timeline */
.timeline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin:10px 0 18px;}
.tl-item{display:flex;gap:18px;position:relative;padding-bottom:28px;}
.tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0;}
.tl-dot-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
.tl-dot{width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--accent-soft);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:3px;}
.tl-item-line{flex:1;width:2px;background:var(--border-strong);margin-top:4px;}
.tl-item:last-child .tl-item-line{display:none;}
.tl-content{flex:1;padding-bottom:6px;}
.tl-content .tl-time{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent-2);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px;}
.tl-content .tl-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:3px;}
.tl-content .tl-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.5;}

/* accordion */
.acc-group{margin-bottom:18px;}
.acc-item{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.acc-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:15px 18px;
  background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;
}
.acc-head .acc-n{min-width:26px;height:26px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;text-transform:lowercase;}
.acc-head .acc-chevron{margin-left:auto;color:var(--text-faint);transition:transform .2s;font-size:11px;}
.acc-item.open .acc-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg);}
.acc-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .35s ease;}
.acc-item.open .acc-body{max-height:600px;}
.acc-body-inner{padding:0 18px 17px 56px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;}

/* hero */
.hero-screen{
  min-height:calc(100vh - 90px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;position:relative;isolation:isolate;
}
.hero-glow{position:absolute;width:560px;height:560px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--accent-glow),transparent 70%);opacity:.4;filter:blur(10px);top:-160px;pointer-events:none;}
.hero-eyebrow{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:20px;}
.hero-title{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,52px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:20px;color:var(--navy);}
.hero-title span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent-2),var(--accent));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
.hero-desc{max-width:600px;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:34px;}
.hero-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:38px;}
.hero-meta b{color:var(--text-dim);}
.btn-primary{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:800;
  border:none;padding:15px 34px;border-radius:40px;font-size:14.5px;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px var(--accent-glow);transition:.2s;
}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -12px var(--accent-glow);}
.btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(0);}

/* Tiga lapis (belakang->depan): .cover-bg-img (foto, kecerahannya bisa
   diatur lewat filter:brightness() yang ditanam generator.py) -> .cover-bg-
   gradient (gradasi gelap BAWAAN, selalu ada terlepas ada foto atau nggak -
   ini yang jamin judul putih tetap kebaca) -> konten (judul/desc/tombol).
   Dipisah jadi div sendiri (bukan langsung background-image di container
   yang sama dengan teks) SUPAYA filter kecerahan cuma kena fotonya, gak
   ikut meredupkan teks - sama alasannya kayak .ending-bg-img slide penutup.
   Modul TANPA foto sampul: .cover-bg-img kosong (gak dirender
   generator.py), gradasinya tetap tampil sendirian - identik perilaku lama
   (sebelum refactor ini, gradient+foto satu background-image yang sama,
   hasil visualnya sama, cuma teknik lapisannya yang berubah). */
.hero-screen.cover-bg{
  min-height:calc(100vh - 90px);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  padding:60px 40px;
}
.cover-bg-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;z-index:0;}
.cover-bg-gradient{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,14,20,.35),rgba(8,10,14,.72));z-index:1;pointer-events:none;}
.cover-bg .hero-eyebrow,.cover-bg .hero-title,.cover-bg .hero-desc,.cover-bg .hero-meta,.cover-bg .btn-primary{position:relative;z-index:2;}

/* ---- Dekorasi grafis opsional (ModuleData.graphicStyle - generator.py
   render_graphic_deco()), INDEPENDEN dari foto sampul/penutup di atas.
   .g-deco dipakai Sampul & Penutup: z-index:1 duduk DI ANTARA layer foto
   (z0) dan teks (z2 - lihat aturan di atas & .ending-bg di bawah, plus
   aturan umum z-index:2 buat teks hero tanpa foto), DOM-order-nya SETELAH
   div foto/gradasi supaya menang tumpuk di antara yang z-index-nya sama.
   .g-deco-behind dipakai slide konten: z-index NEGATIF supaya otomatis
   kalah tumpuk dari BLOK APA PUN (card/accordion/tabs/dst) tanpa perlu
   nyentuh CSS tiap jenis blok satu-satu - amannya berkat `isolation:isolate`
   di .hero-screen/.slide-frame (containment lokal, z-index gak bocor ke
   elemen lain di halaman). Isi di dalamnya cuma bentuk dekoratif murni CSS
   (blob/orb/dot/dst, lihat GRAPHIC_DECO di generator.py) - `pointer-events:
   none` di semua level biar gak pernah nyerobot klik. */
/* `container-type:size` bikin unit cq* di dalam dekorasi (ditanam
   generator.py, lihat _responsive_geometry) ngukur ke kotak pembungkus ini -
   hasilnya dekorasi tampil dengan PROPORSI SAMA di ukuran render apa pun
   (panel "Preview langsung" di builder ~626x295, layar penuh ~1320x810, Web
   Object Storyline/KLC ukuran lain lagi). Aman dikasih size containment
   karena dua-duanya `position:absolute;inset:0` - ukurannya datang dari
   containing block, BUKAN dari isinya (semua anaknya absolute juga), jadi
   gak ada risiko tinggi collapse ke 0 kayak kalau containment ini dipasang
   di .slide-frame yang tingginya ngikutin isi. Browser tanpa dukungan
   container query (Chrome <105/Safari <16) mengabaikan baris ini DAN semua
   deklarasi ber-unit cq*, lalu jatuh ke fallback px yang ditulis generator.py
   tepat sebelumnya - dekorasi tetap muncul, cuma gak ikut menyesuaikan. */
.g-deco{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;container-type:size;}
.g-deco-behind{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;container-type:size;}
.g-blob,.g-orb,.g-dotgrid,.g-bracket,.g-tri,.g-ring,.g-dot,.g-dash,.g-arcband,.g-rectstack{position:absolute;}
/* corner-bracket duduk PENUH DI DALAM sudut (offset positif, bukan bleed
   negatif kayak blob/orb/tri) dan nunjuk lurus ke arah judul yang TERPUSAT -
   satu-satunya gaya dengan geometri kayak gitu. Proporsinya udah dikecilin
   supaya aman di kanvas pendek yang realistis (diverifikasi 50px jarak aman
   di hero 550px - skenario asli laporan user), TAPI scaling proporsional
   apa pun matematisnya selalu ada titik container makin pendek di mana
   reach-nya == posisi mulai judul (keduanya sama-sama menyusut seiring
   tinggi kontainer, gak ada margin px tetap yang bisa jamin nol tabrakan
   selamanya). Jaring pengaman: di kontainer SANGAT pendek (Web
   Object/embed mungil), garisnya disembunyikan aja daripada nabrak. */
@container (max-height: 420px){ .g-bracket{display:none;} }
.g-orb{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-glow), transparent 72%);}
.g-dotgrid{background-image:radial-gradient(var(--accent) 1.2px, transparent 1.5px);background-size:12px 12px;}
.g-tri{clip-path:polygon(50% 0%, 0% 100%, 100% 100%);}
.g-ring{border-radius:50%;background:transparent;}
.g-dot{border-radius:50%;}
.g-dash{border-radius:2px;}
.g-arcband{border-radius:50%;}
.g-rectstack{border-radius:9px;background:transparent;}
/* Berlaku SELALU (bukan cuma di dalam .cover-bg/.ending-bg) - slide penutup
   TANPA foto latar gak punya aturan z-index buat teksnya sama sekali secara
   default (cuma dapet position:relative bawaan dari .hero-screen), jadi
   tanpa ini teks bisa ketiban .g-deco (z1) begitu gaya grafis dipilih. */
.hero-eyebrow,.hero-title,.hero-desc,.hero-meta,.btn-primary,.recap-reopen{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.cover-bg .hero-title{color:#ffffff;}
.cover-bg .hero-desc{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);}

/* ---- Gambar latar opsional slide penutup (ModuleData.endingImageDataUri) ----
   Beda dari .cover-bg: kecerahan gambarnya bisa diatur penyusun modul (lewat
   filter:brightness() yang ditanam generator.py), makanya gambar ditaruh di
   DIV TERPISAH (.ending-bg-img) di belakang teks, bukan background-image
   langsung di container yang sama - kalau container yang kena filter,
   teksnya ikut meredup juga. .summary-screen jaga tampilan lama (padding
   ringkas, gak ada bingkai) buat modul TANPA gambar latar - byte-identical
   ke sebelum fitur ini ada. */
.summary-screen{min-height:auto;padding:30px 0;}
.summary-screen.ending-bg{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:60px 40px 50px;}
.ending-bg-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;z-index:0;}
/* :not(.g-deco) - tanpa ini, .g-deco ikut kesapu jadi position:relative
   (dari absolute) dan patahin layout inset:0-nya sendiri. z-index:1 yang
   dikasih ke sini kebetulan sama kayak punya .g-deco sendiri - amannya dari
   DOM order (.g-deco ditaruh generator.py SEBELUM .hero-eyebrow/.hero-title,
   jadi di antara yang z-index-nya seri, teks tetap menang tumpuk). */
.ending-bg>*:not(.ending-bg-img):not(.g-deco){position:relative;z-index:1;}
.ending-bg .hero-eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);}
.ending-bg .hero-title{color:#ffffff;}
/* Tanpa ini deskripsi penutup kepakai var(--text-dim) yang gelap - gak kebaca
   di atas gambar latar yang memang sengaja diredupkan. Nilainya disamakan
   dengan .cover-bg .hero-desc biar dua layar itu konsisten. */
.ending-bg .hero-desc{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);}

/* bottom nav */
#bottomnav{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 34px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--bar-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);flex-shrink:0;
}
.nav-btn{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:40px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);
}
.nav-btn:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.nav-btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;}
.nav-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));color:var(--on-accent);border:none;}
#dots{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:0 auto;}
.dotm{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);transition:.2s;}
.dotm.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);width:18px;border-radius:4px;}

/* quiz */
.quiz-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:28px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.quiz-num{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--violet);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:9px;}
.quiz-q{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--navy);}
.quiz-opt{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-dim);
  font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;
}
.quiz-opt:hover:not(.locked){border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text);}
.quiz-opt .qletter{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--text-faint);}
.quiz-opt.correct{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--text);}
.quiz-opt.correct .qletter{background:var(--green);color:#fff;}
.quiz-opt.wrong{border-color:var(--rose);background:var(--rose-soft);color:var(--text);animation:quiz-shake .45s ease-in-out 1, quiz-glow-rose 1.1s ease-out 1;}
.quiz-opt.wrong .qletter{background:var(--rose);color:#fff;}
.quiz-opt.correct::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-60%;width:35%;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.85),transparent);
  transform:skewX(-20deg);pointer-events:none;
  animation:quiz-shimmer-sweep .9s ease-out 1;
}
@keyframes quiz-shimmer-sweep{
  0%{left:-60%;opacity:0;}
  12%{opacity:1;}
  100%{left:130%;opacity:0;}
}
@keyframes quiz-shake{
  0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}
  20%{transform:translateX(-4px);}
  40%{transform:translateX(4px);}
  60%{transform:translateX(-3px);}
  80%{transform:translateX(3px);}
}
@keyframes quiz-glow-rose{
  0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(192,74,68,.4);}
  55%{box-shadow:0 0 16px 3px rgba(192,74,68,.28);}
  100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(192,74,68,0);}
}
.quiz-explain{margin-top:10px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-dim);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:13px 15px;display:none;}
.quiz-explain.show{display:block;animation:riseIn .3s ease;}
.quiz-explain b{color:var(--accent-2);}

.checkpoint-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:34px;}
.checkpoint-head .cp-icon{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--violet-soft);color:var(--violet);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:24px;margin:0 auto 16px;}
.cp-result{
  text-align:center;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
  padding:30px;display:none;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);margin-top:24px;
}
.cp-result.show{display:block;animation:riseIn .4s ease;}
.cp-score{font-size:42px;font-weight:800;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:4px;}
.cp-score-lbl{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:20px;}

/* summary screen */
.summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin:26px 0;}
@media(max-width:760px){.summary-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.summary-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:18px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.summary-card .sc-val{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent-2);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;}
.summary-card .sc-lbl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:4px;}

#lock-toast{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:96px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(12px);
  background:rgba(27,42,74,.72);color:#f5efe4;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;
  padding:13px 20px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);
  max-width:420px;text-align:center;z-index:60;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .25s ease,transform .25s ease;
}
#lock-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}

#devmode-modal-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.45);z-index:70;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
#devmode-modal-overlay.show{display:flex;}
#devmode-modal{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:26px 28px;
  width:320px;max-width:88vw;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
#devmode-modal h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;}
#devmode-modal p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:16px;}
#devmode-pw-input{
  width:100%;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px;
}
#devmode-pw-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);}
#devmode-modal-error{display:none;color:var(--rose);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px;}
#devmode-modal-error.show{display:block;}
#devmode-modal-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:6px;}

/* Gerbang identitas — cuma muncul di modul yang "Rekam aktivitas peserta"-nya
   dicentang DAN identitasnya belum kedapetan dari LMS. z-index di atas
   devmode modal karena ini gerbang: modul gak boleh dimulai sebelum diisi. */
#identity-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  z-index:90;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
#identity-overlay.show{display:flex;}
.idn-panel{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:30px 32px;
  width:400px;max-width:92vw;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  animation:riseIn .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
/* Form dan panel konfirmasi gantian tampil di overlay yang sama. */
.idn-panel[hidden]{display:none;}
.idn-panel .idn-icon{
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:14px;
}
.idn-panel h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:7px;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;}
.idn-panel p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:18px;}
.idn-panel label{display:block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:5px;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.idn-panel input{
  width:100%;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:13px;
}
.idn-panel input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);}
#identity-error{display:none;color:var(--rose);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:11px;}
#identity-error.show{display:block;}
.idn-panel .idn-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);line-height:1.5;margin:14px 0 0;}
#idn-prefill-note{display:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent-2);margin:-6px 0 11px;}
#idn-prefill-note.show{display:block;}

/* Gerbang peringatan kecepatan baca — muncul sekali per section sebelum
   percobaan kuis pertama, cuma kalau ada slide yang keklik-lewat terlalu
   cepat. Pola overlay sama persis kayak #identity-overlay. */
#reading-warning-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  z-index:85;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
#reading-warning-overlay.show{display:flex;}
/* Panel konfirmasi: data dibalikin gede-gede biar beneran kebaca, bukan
   diklik buru-buru. NIP pakai font mono + spasi per kelompok supaya digit
   ketuker/kelewat gampang keliatan mata. */
.idn-review{
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;
}
.idn-review-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;}
.idn-review-row + .idn-review-row{margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
.idn-review-label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-faint);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.idn-review strong{font-size:15px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;word-break:break-word;}
.idn-review-nip{
  font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:16px !important;letter-spacing:.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
#idn-confirm-warn{display:none;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.55;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--rose);background:rgba(225,29,72,.08);border:1px solid rgba(225,29,72,.25);
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:9px 11px;margin-bottom:13px;}
#idn-confirm-warn.show{display:block;}

.nav-section.locked .nav-section-head{color:var(--text-faint);cursor:pointer;}
.nav-section.locked .nsh-icon{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-faint);}
.nav-section.locked .nsh-title{opacity:.65;}
.nav-section.locked .nsh-lock{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-faint);}

/* mobile */
@media(max-width:900px){
  #sidebar{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;transform:translateX(-100%);width:86vw;max-width:320px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}
  #sidebar.open{transform:translateX(0);}
  #sidebar-close{display:block;margin-left:auto;background:none;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;}
  #menu-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;}
  #overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.35);z-index:35;}
  #overlay.show{display:block;}
  #viewport{padding:30px 20px 100px;}
  #topbar,#bottomnav{padding:14px 18px;}
}

/* modal popup (supplementary detail blocks, smooth scale/fade entrance) */
.modal-trigger{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:15px 18px;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);
  transition:.18s;margin-bottom:18px;
}
.modal-trigger:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
.modal-trigger .ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0;}
.modal-trigger .chevron{margin-left:auto;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:12px;}
/* left:314px = lebar #sidebar, BUKAN 0.
   Sidebar itu rel tetap yang selalu kelihatan di desktop, jadi overlay yang
   membentang dari tepi kiri layar bikin popup-nya ketengah di tengah LAYAR -
   yang artinya kelewat ke kiri dari kolom isi yang lagi dibaca. Dengan digeser
   selebar sidebar, titik tengahnya jadi titik tengah kolom isi, persis di
   depan mata. Di bawah 900px sidebar-nya jadi panel geser (off-canvas) dan
   kolom isi memenuhi layar, jadi offset-nya dibalikin ke 0 di media query
   mobile di bawah. */
.modal-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0 0 0 314px;background:rgba(15,18,26,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s ease;z-index:300;
}
@media(max-width:900px){.modal-overlay{inset:0;}}
.modal-overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
.modal-box{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);max-width:720px;width:100%;
  max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:30px 32px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  position:relative;transform:translateY(28px) scale(.95);opacity:0;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .3s ease;
}
.modal-overlay.open .modal-box{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);opacity:1;}
.modal-box h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:16px;padding-right:30px;}
/* Gambar opsional di dalam popup. max-width:100% + height:auto supaya gambar
   besar mengecil mengikuti kotak popup, bukan melebar keluar dan bikin
   .modal-box (yang cuma overflow-y) menggulir menyamping. */
.modal-box .modal-img{
  display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;height:auto;
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);margin:0 0 16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);
}
.modal-close{
  position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--surface-2);border:none;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:.15s;
}
.modal-close:hover{background:var(--rose-soft);color:var(--rose);}

/* ---------------- Knowledge Check (popup saat mau pindah slide) ---------------- */
#kc-popup-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  z-index:86;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
#kc-popup-overlay.show{display:flex;}
.kc-popup-panel{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);max-width:560px;width:100%;
  max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:26px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.kc-popup-panel h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);}
.kc-popup-lede{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.5;}
#kc-popup-continue{display:none;width:100%;margin-top:6px;}
.kc-item{margin-bottom:18px;}
.kc-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
/* ---- Blok Articulate 360 ---- */
.art-card{padding:14px;}
.art-frame{position:relative;width:100%;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#000;}
.art-iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block;}
.art-frame:fullscreen{padding-bottom:0!important;height:100%!important;border-radius:0;}
.art-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.art-status{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-faint);font-weight:600;}
.art-status.art-done{color:var(--green);}
.art-full{
  font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;
  padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);transition:.15s;
}
.art-full:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
.art-placeholder{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:16px;border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);}
.art-ph-icon{font-size:26px;line-height:1;color:var(--text-faint);}
.art-ph-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.55;}
.kc-q{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.5;}
.kc-retry-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);margin:-8px 0 10px;font-style:italic;}
.kc-opts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.kc-opt{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;
  padding:12px 15px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);color:var(--text);font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:.15s;font-family:inherit;
}
.kc-opt:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent);}
.kc-opt:disabled{cursor:default;}
.kc-item.kc-locked .kc-opt:not(.kc-correct):not(.kc-wrong){opacity:.6;}
.kc-opt.kc-correct{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--text);font-weight:600;}
.kc-opt.kc-wrong{border-color:var(--rose);background:var(--rose-soft);color:var(--text);font-weight:600;}
.kc-fb{
  margin-top:10px;padding:11px 14px;background:var(--surface-2);
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text-dim);
}
.kc-verdict{font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.kc-verdict.ok{color:var(--green);}
.kc-verdict.no{color:var(--rose);}
.kc-fb-text b{color:var(--accent-2);}
.kc-fb-retry{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-faint);}

/* ---------- Popup "Ringkasan Belajarmu" (rekap peserta buat dirinya sendiri)
   Muncul di slide Ringkasan. Nadanya sengaja CERMIN KEMAJUAN DIRI, bukan
   rapor/pengawasan — makanya gak ada nilai, gak ada peringkat, dan gak ada
   yang bisa dilihat peserta lain. Pola overlay-nya sama kayak #kc-popup. */
#recap-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  z-index:87;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
#recap-overlay.show{display:flex;}
.recap-panel{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);max-width:620px;width:100%;
  max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:28px 30px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  animation:riseIn .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);position:relative;
}
.recap-close{
  position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-dim);
  font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;
}
.recap-close:hover{background:var(--surface-hover);color:var(--text);}
.recap-eyebrow{
  font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent-2);margin-bottom:8px;
}
.recap-headline{
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;
  color:var(--navy);line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 6px;
}
.recap-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 0 20px;line-height:1.55;}

.recap-stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.recap-stat{
  flex:1 1 128px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:13px 15px;
}
.recap-stat-label{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--text-faint);margin-bottom:5px;
}
.recap-stat-value{
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.15;
}
.recap-stat-note{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;}

.recap-chart{
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  padding:14px 10px 6px;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.recap-chart-title{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--text-faint);margin:0 0 4px 10px;
}

/* Tiap poin narasi. Warnanya cuma penanda arah (hijau = udah oke, amber =
   layak ditengok lagi) — sengaja BUKAN merah: ini bukan vonis salah. */
.recap-point{
  display:flex;gap:11px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);margin-bottom:10px;
}
.recap-point .rp-ic{font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;flex:0 0 auto;}
.recap-point .rp-tx{font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--text-dim);}
.recap-point .rp-tx b{color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;}
.recap-point.good{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);}
.recap-point.bad{border-color:var(--amber);background:var(--amber-soft);}

.recap-closing{
  margin-top:16px;padding:15px 17px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  background:var(--navy-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);
  font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--text);
}
.recap-loading,.recap-empty{
  padding:34px 10px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-faint);line-height:1.6;
}
#recap-actions{margin-top:18px;}
#recap-actions .nav-btn{width:100%;}

/* Tombol buka-lagi di slide Ringkasan — rekapnya bisa ditengok berkali-kali,
   bukan sekali lewat terus hilang. */
.recap-reopen{margin-top:22px;}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .recap-panel{padding:22px 18px;}
  .recap-stat{flex:1 1 100%;}
}

/* ============================= CO-CREATION =============================
   Tombol melayang SENGAJA duduk 96px dari bawah, bukan menempel di tepi:
   #bottomnav itu bagian dari alur layout (tinggi ~76px), jadi tombol di
   bottom:0 bakal menimpa tombol "Sebelumnya/Selanjutnya". Angka 96px sama
   dengan yang sudah dipakai #lock-toast — dua elemen melayang ini jadi
   sejajar, bukan masing-masing punya garis sendiri. */
/* Bentuk & warnanya SENGAJA gak sama dengan tombol "Selanjutnya" di
   #bottomnav. Dulu dua-duanya pil besar berlatar gradien aksen, jadi di layar
   kelihatan seperti sepasang tombol navigasi — padahal yang satu memajukan
   slide dan yang satu membuka catatan. Sekarang: lembar kertas kecil
   (persegi bersudut tumpul dengan pojok kanan-atas terlipat), berlatar
   permukaan terang dengan teks gelap. Siluet & warnanya beda jauh, jadi
   kebaca sebagai "alat", bukan "lanjut".

   Sudut lipatan dipotong pakai clip-path. Karena clip-path ikut memotong
   box-shadow DAN border, bayangan & garis tepinya digambar pakai
   drop-shadow() yang mengikuti siluet hasil potongan — bukan kotak aslinya. */
#coc-fab{
  --coc-lipat:14px;
  position:fixed;right:26px;bottom:96px;z-index:60;
  /* Padding kanan lebih lebar dari yang lain: pojok kanan-atas dipotong
     selebar --coc-lipat, jadi teks yang mepet ke situ bakal ketimpa lipatan. */
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 18px 9px 12px;border-radius:9px;
  border:none;background:var(--surface);
  color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;
  cursor:pointer;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0, calc(100% - var(--coc-lipat)) 0, 100% var(--coc-lipat), 100% 100%, 0 100%);
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0.5px rgba(22,33,62,.45)) drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(22,33,62,.20));
  transition:transform .18s,filter .18s;
}
#coc-fab:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px);
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0.5px rgba(22,33,62,.55)) drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(22,33,62,.26));
}
/* Segitiga lipatan di pojok kanan-atas: separuh kiri-bawah kotak 14x14 yang
   masih tersisa setelah clip-path memotong separuh kanan-atasnya. */
#coc-fab::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;right:0;pointer-events:none;
  width:var(--coc-lipat);height:var(--coc-lipat);
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom left,transparent 50%,var(--surface-2) 50%);
}
/* Pensilnya diberi warna aksen — satu-satunya sentuhan warna di kertas ini,
   sekaligus penanda fungsi yang tetap kebaca waktu labelnya disembunyikan. */
.coc-fab-icon{font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent-2);}
.coc-fab-count{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:17px;height:17px;
  padding:0 5px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);
  font-size:10px;font-weight:800;
}

#coc-overlay,#coc-menu-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,33,62,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  z-index:88;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;
}
#coc-overlay.show,#coc-menu-overlay.show{display:flex;}
.coc-panel{
  position:relative;width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:86vh;overflow-y:auto;
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:26px 28px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.coc-menu-panel{max-width:660px;}
.coc-close{
  position:absolute;top:16px;right:16px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--surface-2);border:none;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;
}
.coc-close:hover{background:var(--surface-3);color:var(--text);}
.coc-panel-eyebrow{
  margin:0 0 4px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-2);
}
.coc-slide-label{margin-bottom:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--text);}
.coc-slide-label .coc-sec{
  display:block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-faint);margin-bottom:2px;
}
.coc-list{margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.coc-note{
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:12px 14px;
}
.coc-note-text{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text);white-space:pre-wrap;}
.coc-note-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.coc-note-ts{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-right:auto;}
.coc-mini{
  background:none;border:none;padding:2px 4px;font-family:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--accent-2);cursor:pointer;
}
.coc-mini:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
.coc-mini-danger{color:#c04a44;}
.coc-empty{
  padding:22px 10px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-faint);line-height:1.6;margin:0;
}
.coc-input{
  width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;resize:vertical;
}
.coc-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);}
.coc-panel-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.coc-counter{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-right:auto;}
.coc-counter-warn{color:#c04a44;}
.coc-panel-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;}
.coc-panel-actions .nav-btn{padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px;}

.coc-menu-title{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);}
.coc-menu-hint{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text-faint);}
.coc-menu-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
.coc-menu-sec{
  margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-faint);
}
.coc-menu-sec:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.coc-menu-slide{margin-bottom:8px;}
.coc-menu-slide-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;
  padding:6px 2px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;
}
.coc-menu-slide-head:hover .coc-menu-jump{opacity:1;}
.coc-menu-jump{
  margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-2);opacity:.55;transition:opacity .18s;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.coc-menu-note{
  display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px 13px;margin-bottom:6px;
  font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;
}
.coc-menu-note:hover{background:var(--surface-3);transform:translateX(2px);}
.coc-menu-note-text{
  display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:5px;white-space:pre-wrap;
}

/* Entri sidebar, sejajar section tapi tanpa gembok — menu ini selalu bisa
   dibuka, termasuk sebelum semua section selesai. */
.nav-coc-btn{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:8px;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;
}
.nav-coc-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
.nav-coc-icon{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:26px;height:26px;flex-shrink:0;
  border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2);font-size:13px;
}
.nav-coc-count{
  margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent-2);
  background:var(--accent-soft);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;
}

@media(max-width:760px){
  /* #bottomnav menyusut di layar kecil (padding 14px), jadi tombolnya ikut
     turun — kalau tetap 96px dia menggantung terlalu jauh dari tepi. */
  #coc-fab{right:16px;bottom:86px;padding:8px 16px 8px 10px;font-size:11.5px;}
  .coc-panel{padding:22px 18px;}
}

/* Per-slide voiceover player, injected above slide content by applySlideAudio */
.slide-audio{margin:0 0 18px;}
.slide-audio audio{width:100%;height:38px;}

/* YouTube facade: thumbnail asli video + tombol play, klik -> iframe player
   (playYouTube). Kotaknya sudah beraspek-rasio lewat inline style dari
   generator (padding-bottom 56.25% / 177.78%). */
.video-facade{transition:filter .2s ease;}
.video-facade::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.16);transition:background .2s ease;}
.video-facade:hover::after{background:rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
.video-play{
  position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:2;
  width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,20,22,.78);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:.2s ease;
}
.video-facade:hover .video-play{background:#cc0000;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.07);}
.video-play::before{
  content:'';border-style:solid;border-width:12px 0 12px 20px;
  border-color:transparent transparent transparent #fff;margin-left:5px;
}

/* affordance pulse — subtle recurring hint on click-to-reveal chevrons
   (accordion, sidebar section/bundle toggle, modal trigger) so users
   notice they're clickable without needing to hover first. Stops once
   opened so it doesn't fight the rotate-on-open transform. */
@keyframes affordance-pulse{
  0%,100%{ opacity:.55; transform:scale(1); }
  50%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1.22); }
}
.acc-chevron, .nsh-chevron, .nav-bundle-head .bundle-chevron, .modal-trigger .chevron{
  animation:affordance-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.acc-item.open .acc-chevron,
.nav-section.open .nsh-chevron,
.nav-bundle.open .bundle-chevron{
  animation:none;
}

/* ---- Penanda "blok ini bisa diklik" ----
   Accordion, tab, langkah alur, dan tombol modal kelihatan sama saja dengan
   kartu statis sampai peserta kebetulan menyorotnya — jadi konten yang harus
   digali gampang kelewat. Tiap blok interaktif dikasih sapuan kilau tipis
   plus tepi yang menyala sekejap, berulang pelan: undangan yang kebaca tanpa
   bikin halaman jadi lampu disko.

   Digambar di ::before ber-inset:0, bukan di box-shadow elemennya, supaya
   (a) gak menimpa border/shadow yang sudah dipunyai tiap blok, dan (b) gak
   butuh overflow:hidden — badge .fs-badge yang sengaja nongol di luar
   .flow-step tetap utuh. Kilaunya digeser lewat background-position, bukan
   transform, biar gak pernah keluar dari kotaknya sendiri; di luar sapuan
   posisinya diparkir jauh di kiri/kanan sehingga loop-nya gak kelihatan
   lompat. Warnanya dicampur ke transparan (bukan --accent-soft yang pekat)
   biar teks di baliknya tetap kebaca waktu kilau lewat.

   Berhenti begitu bloknya pernah dipakai (lihat tandaiTerpakai() di JS):
   undangannya sudah selesai tugasnya, dan animasi yang jalan terus di konten
   yang lagi dibaca cuma jadi gangguan. */
@keyframes clickable-hint{
  0%       { background-position:150% 0; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px transparent; }
  16%      { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-glow); }
  44%      { background-position:-70% 0; }
  56%,100% { background-position:-70% 0; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px transparent; }
}
.acc-group:not(.seen) .acc-item:not(.open),
.flow:not(.seen) .flow-step,
.tabs:not(.seen) .tab-btn:not(.active),
.modal-trigger:not(.seen){ position:relative; }
.acc-group:not(.seen) .acc-item:not(.open)::before,
.flow:not(.seen) .flow-step::before,
.tabs:not(.seen) .tab-btn:not(.active)::before,
.modal-trigger:not(.seen)::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 38%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 16%,transparent) 50%,transparent 62%);
  background-size:260% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  animation:clickable-hint 5.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite;
}
/* Tab itu pil kecil — sapuan penuh di dalamnya kelihatan berat, jadi yang
   dipakai cuma kedip tepinya. */
.tabs:not(.seen) .tab-btn:not(.active)::before{ background:none; }
/* Digeser sedikit biar tiap blok di satu slide gak berkedip serempak. */
.acc-group:not(.seen) .acc-item:nth-child(2n)::before,
.flow:not(.seen) .flow-step:nth-child(4n+3)::before,
.tabs:not(.seen) .tab-btn:nth-child(2n)::before{ animation-delay:1.3s; }
.acc-group:not(.seen) .acc-item:nth-child(3n)::before,
.flow:not(.seen) .flow-step:nth-child(4n+5)::before{ animation-delay:2.6s; }

/* Undangan ini murni dekoratif — buat yang mematikan animasi di sistemnya,
   blok tetap kebuka lewat hover/fokus seperti biasa. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .acc-chevron,.nsh-chevron,.nav-bundle-head .bundle-chevron,.modal-trigger .chevron,
  .acc-item::before,.flow-step::before,.tab-btn::before,.modal-trigger::before{ animation:none; }
}

/* final-quiz completion card (aesthetic, only shown on the LAST section's
   quiz once passed) — badge pop-in + reuses .cp-result's riseIn fade */
.cp-final{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:18px 10px 8px;}
.cp-final-glow{position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;left:50%;top:-260px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--accent-glow),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px);pointer-events:none;}
.cp-final-badge{position:relative;width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:34px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px var(--accent-glow);animation:badgePop .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) .15s both;}
.cp-final-title{position:relative;font-size:clamp(21px,3.6vw,28px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--navy);}
.cp-final-title b{color:var(--accent-2);}
.cp-final-sub{position:relative;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;text-wrap:balance;}
@keyframes badgePop{0%{transform:scale(.4);opacity:0;}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="app">
  <div id="overlay" onclick="closeSidebar()"></div>
  <div id="lock-toast"></div>

  <div id="identity-overlay">
    <div id="identity-box" class="idn-panel">
      <div class="idn-icon">👋</div>
      <h3>Sebelum mulai</h3>
      <p>Isi data kamu dulu ya. Ini dipakai buat mencatat aktivitas belajar sebagai bahan evaluasi pembelajaran.</p>
      <label for="idn-nama">Nama Lengkap <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--text-faint)">(sesuai HRIS)</span></label>
      <input type="text" id="idn-nama" autocomplete="name" placeholder="mis. Budi Santoso"
             onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') document.getElementById('idn-nip').focus()">
      <div id="idn-prefill-note"></div>
      <label for="idn-nip">NIP</label>
      <input type="text" id="idn-nip" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="18 digit angka"
             oninput="formatNipInput(this)"
             onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') submitIdentity()">
      <div id="identity-error"></div>
      <button class="nav-btn primary" style="width:100%" onclick="submitIdentity()">Lanjut →</button>
      <p class="idn-note">Data ini cuma dipakai untuk keperluan evaluasi dan pengembangan pembelajaran.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Panel konfirmasi: NIP jadi kunci penggabung data lintas modul, jadi
         satu digit salah ketik bikin rekaman orang itu pecah jadi dua "orang"
         tanpa ada yang sadar. Cek panjang digit gak cukup — digit ketuker
         (1001 -> 1010) tetap lolos. Makanya datanya dibalikin buat dibaca
         ulang sebelum dipakai. -->
    <div id="identity-confirm" class="idn-panel" hidden>
      <div class="idn-icon">🔎</div>
      <h3>Sudah benar?</h3>
      <p>Cek sekali lagi ya. Kalau NIP-nya keliru, aktivitas belajar kamu bisa tercatat atas nama orang lain.</p>
      <div class="idn-review">
        <div class="idn-review-row">
          <span class="idn-review-label">Nama</span>
          <strong id="idn-confirm-nama"></strong>
        </div>
        <div class="idn-review-row">
          <span class="idn-review-label">NIP</span>
          <strong id="idn-confirm-nip" class="idn-review-nip"></strong>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="idn-confirm-warn"></div>
      <button class="nav-btn primary" style="width:100%" onclick="confirmIdentity()">Ya, sudah benar →</button>
      <button class="nav-btn" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px" onclick="backToIdentityForm()">← Betulkan</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="devmode-modal-overlay" onclick="if(event.target===this) closeDevModeModal()">
    <div id="devmode-modal">
      <h3>Masuk Dev Mode</h3>
      <p>Akses khusus untuk keperluan pengembangan dan pengujian.</p>
      <input type="password" id="devmode-pw-input" placeholder="Password" autocomplete="off" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') submitDevModePassword()">
      <div id="devmode-modal-error">Password salah.</div>
      <div id="devmode-modal-actions">
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="closeDevModeModal()">Batal</button>
        <button class="nav-btn primary" onclick="submitDevModePassword()">Masuk</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="reading-warning-overlay">
    <div class="idn-panel">
      <div class="idn-icon">👀</div>
      <h3>Sebentar dulu</h3>
      <p>Kami lihat beberapa halaman terbuka cukup cepat. Kamu yakin mau langsung masuk kuis atau pelajari kembali?</p>
      <button class="nav-btn primary" style="width:100%" onclick="chooseReadingWarningYakin()">Yakin, lanjut ke kuis →</button>
      <button class="nav-btn" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px" onclick="chooseReadingWarningKembali()">← Pelajari lagi</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Knowledge-check popup: muncul begitu peserta coba pindah dari slide
       yang punya blok Knowledge Check dan belum semua soalnya dijawab.
       Isinya (kc-popup-body) dirender JS di kcOpenPopup(); tombol Lanjut
       cuma nongol setelah semua soal terjawab (kcUpdateContinueBtn). -->
  <div id="kc-popup-overlay">
    <div class="kc-popup-panel">
      <h3>Sebelum lanjut</h3>
      <p class="kc-popup-lede">Silahkan jawab pertanyaan di bawah ini, ya!</p>
      <div id="kc-popup-body"></div>
      <button class="nav-btn primary" id="kc-popup-continue" onclick="kcContinue()">Lanjut →</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Popup "Ringkasan Belajarmu": rekap peserta buat DIRINYA SENDIRI, muncul
       sekali begitu sampai slide Ringkasan (bisa dibuka lagi lewat tombol di
       slide itu). Isinya dirender JS di recapRender() dari angka yang dibalikin
       endpoint /api/activity/my-recap. -->
  <div id="recap-overlay">
    <div class="recap-panel">
      <button class="recap-close" onclick="recapClose()" aria-label="Tutup">✕</button>
      <div id="recap-body"></div>
      <div id="recap-actions"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Co-creation: tombol melayang (cuma di slide materi), panel tulis
       catatan per slide, dan menu berisi seluruh catatan. Tombolnya duduk DI
       ATAS #bottomnav (lihat CSS .coc-fab), bukan menimpanya. -->
  <button id="coc-fab" onclick="cocOpen()" style="display:none">
    <span class="coc-fab-icon">✎</span>
    <span class="coc-fab-label">Catatan</span>
    <span class="coc-fab-count" style="display:none"></span>
  </button>

  <div id="coc-overlay">
    <div class="coc-panel">
      <button class="coc-close" onclick="cocClose()" aria-label="Tutup">✕</button>
      <p class="coc-panel-eyebrow">Catatan Co-creation</p>
      <div id="coc-slide-label" class="coc-slide-label"></div>
      <div id="coc-list" class="coc-list"></div>
      <textarea id="coc-input" class="coc-input" maxlength="2000" rows="4"
        oninput="cocUpdateCounter()"
        placeholder="Tulis apa pun yang terbesit soal materi ini — pertanyaan, keraguan, contoh dari pekerjaanmu, atau hal yang mau kamu tajamkan di kelas nanti."></textarea>
      <div class="coc-panel-foot">
        <span id="coc-counter" class="coc-counter"></span>
        <span class="coc-panel-actions">
          <button id="coc-cancel-edit" class="nav-btn" style="display:none" onclick="cocCancelEdit()">Batal</button>
          <button id="coc-submit" class="nav-btn primary" onclick="cocSubmit()">Simpan catatan</button>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="coc-menu-overlay">
    <div class="coc-panel coc-menu-panel">
      <button class="coc-close" onclick="cocMenuClose()" aria-label="Tutup">✕</button>
      <p class="coc-panel-eyebrow">Co-creation</p>
      <h3 class="coc-menu-title">Semua catatanmu</h3>
      <p id="coc-menu-note" class="coc-menu-hint"></p>
      <div id="coc-menu-body" class="coc-menu-body"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
